name: Ink on cyan / Spotlight
look: Thick black brush ink with pressure on a pool of cyan light in a dark teal void, one violet accent on the joints; plate B is the same frame as light wire with isolux rings

axes.base: void: flat dark teal, one pool of light and its beam
axes.line: thick sumi brush through inkPath with a pressure profile per bone, 12 fps boil
axes.tone: light only: the pool as a ramp from beamHot to beam, a glow halo past its edge, shadows in beamDeep on the pool
axes.planB: schematic: the same frame in beamHot wire, isolux rings, a dimension and thin labels
axes.motion: poses on twos, the ink boiling on the 12 fps clock
axes.accent: violet discs on the joints of the one figure that acts
axes.font: thin sans: strokeText hand style, no slant, no jitter, in beamHot
axes.match: silhouette: the joints keep their place and colour across the cut
axes.overlays: a trailing reticle; plate B adds rings, a dimension and labels
